articles.title: Standard Chartered-led Anchorpoint launches Hong Kong dollar stablecoin
articles.snippet: HashKey Exchange and OSL Group are now authorized distributors, enabling institutional and professional investors to mint and redeem HKDAP tokens.

articles.title: HashKey begins beta distribution of Hong Kong-regulated HKDAP stablecoin
articles.snippet: HashKey has become an authorized distributor for Anchorpoint’s HKDAP, expanding institutional access as Hong Kong’s regulated stablecoin market takes shape.

articles.title: Ravencoin hits record low as network exploit puts transactions at risk
articles.snippet: Mining pools controlling most of Ravencoin’s hash rate are building a competing chain that could trigger a three-day reorganization.

articles.title: Ravencoin Crashes 20% as Critical Exploit Threatens to Rollback Network
articles.snippet: Two mining pools controlling most of Ravencoin's hash power are already rebuilding the chain from before Friday's first bad block—here's what a forced rollback would undo.
